page.layout: One column of running text, with line numbers 5 to 35 in the left margin beside the text. Three paragraphs: the continuation from the previous page, then the theses XVI and XVII. A strip at the left edge shows the neighbouring page and is not transcribed. Running head centred at the top, page number top right, catchword and signature at the foot.

main_text.p: quâ quis ita obseruat ritus & ceremonias sacras, vt illæ ancillentur fidei, spei & charitati. Religio vera est interna, vel externa. De religione internâ sic pronuntiat apostolus Iacobus c. 1. v. vlt. Religio pura & inconta-5minata apud Deum & Patrem, hæc est, inuisere orphanos & vi-duas in afflictione ipsorum, & immaculatum sese seruare a mundo. Ex quâ definitione intelligimus, religionem veram & in-ternam complecti dilectionem Dei & proximi, adeoque totum Christianismum. Religio vera externa consistit in 10obseruatione ceremoniarum a Deo præscriptarum: cuiusmodi in V. T. fuerunt sacrificia, conuiuia sacra, certæ lotiones, abstinentia a certis cibis, jeiunia, adoratio coram arcâ fœderis & versus templum, circumcisio, & agnus paschalis: in N. T. prædicatio & auscultatio verbi Dei so-15lennis, & usurpatio sacramentorum prout a Christo sunt instituta. Horum rituum obseruatio hactenus probatur Deo, si ancillētur fidei, spei & charitati. Psalm. 50. Esa. 1. cap. 29. v. 1. 13. c. 58. v. 4. c. 66. v. 3. Matth. 15. v. 7. 8. Hicau-tem prohibentur, repræsentatio Dei per imagines, appro-20batio externæ idololatriæ, magici ritus & illorum appro-batio.

XVI. Societas cum religionis studiosis est, quando cum iis conuersamur, qui Deum colunt ritibus cum verbo ipsius non pugnantibus. Huc 25pertinent connubia, fœdera, conuiuia, & similia.2.Chron. 15. vers. 10. c. 19. vers. 2. Mal. 2. vers. 11. 1. Cor. 6. v. 1. & seqq. c. 10. v. 27. 28.

XVII. Sanctificatio nominis Dei est, qua vti-mur nomine Dei sancte: hoc est, cum celebratione, 30veracitate, reuerentiâ, & circumspectione, vt sermo noster exprimat virtutes primi præcepti. Deut. 8. vers. 8. c. 10. v. 8.1. Sam. 2. v. 20. Sanè cum auiculæ omnesq; aliæ creaturæ sonent laudem Dei, & pro modulo quæque suo gloriam eius enarrent, foedissimum fuerit, si nos hanc musi-35cam & harmoniam ingrato stridore violemus. Psal. 19.

page.notes: The strip at the left edge (fragments such as "lebita", "folum", "Deum", "luere") is the neighbouring page and is not transcribed. The marginal numbers 5 to 35 are printed line numbers and are kept as notes. The printed "& 29." at the foot is given as the catchword; this is uncertain. Reading of "sese seruare" as "sese seruare" is taken from the scan. Reference numbers are copied as printed.
